application_type_full: Prior Approval: Development for electronic communications network
decision_conditions: Due to its design and imposing form incorporating a lattice tower, inappropriate and excessive height, and the top-heavy, bulky appearance of the antenna at its apex, and due to its siting in a prominent position within and at a gateway to the Lee Valley Regional Park, the proposal would appear as an insensitive, prominent, incongruous, and visually jarring addition to the streetscene and environment in this location. This would be detrimental to the visual amenity of nearby residents and visitors to the Lee Valley Regional Park and harmful to the aesthetic quality of the public realm in this location. The structure itself, and the fencing around the mast, would also restrict public accessibility to existing open space with the park. This harm would not be outweighed by the public benefit of the proposed development. Given this, the proposal fails to comply with policies GG1, GG2, G4, D4 and D8 of the London Plan (2021), with policies DMD 37 and DMD 38 of the Development Management Document (2014), and with policies CP9, CP30, CP34 and CP35 of the Core Strategy (2010), and with the National Planning Policy Framework (2021).

The proposed development, by virtue of its scale, height, bulk and siting adjacent to the Green Belt, would appear as visually dominant, intrusive, and unsympathetic in this location on a green edge to the Lee Valley Regional Park, also restricting opportunities for public access to the land. It would be visible from within the Green Belt and given its scale, height and bulk, it would therefore harm the openness of the Green Belt. Given this, the development is inappropriate and there are no very special circumstances which justify its approval in this location. Therefore, the proposal is contrary to section 13 of the National Planning Policy Framework, to policies G2 and G4 of the London Plan (2021), to policies DMD 83 and DMD 89 of the Development Management Document (2014), and to policies CP9, CP30, CP33, CP34 and CP35 of the Core Strategy (2010).
description: Installation of a telecommunications lattice tower  to a maximum height of 25.4m (including 12 x antennae) with 4 x equipment cabinet, at base within 2.1m fenced enclosure and 1 x equipment cabinet at base.
